{{DISPLAYTITLE:Time Magic (''Tactics Advance'')}}
{{Quote|Time mage command. Warp the fabric of time itself.|Description}}
'''Time Magic''' {{J|時魔法|Toki Mahō}} is the action ability for the [[Time Mage (Tactics Advance)|Time Mage]] in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''.

{{See|Time Magic}}
